title: Natural row-cokernel identification with the swapped tensor complex
statement: Let R be a commutative ring. For every pair of R-modules M,N and projective resolutions P of M and Q of N [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], put A=A(P,Q) [def-weil-pbc-tensor-bicomplex]. There is a simultaneous family e_{M,N,P,Q}: A.opcycles(0) ≅ Q tensor_R M [def-weil-pbc-chain-complex-tensor-module]. For modules M,N,M',N', resolutions P,Q,P',Q', maps f:M→M', g:N→N', and augmentation-compatible chain maps a:P→P', b:Q→Q', e_{M,N,P,Q} followed by b tensor f equals the induced row-cokernel map of A(a,b) followed by e_{M',N',P',Q'}. The identification uses the tensor factor swap [lem-weil-pbc-module-tensor-comm].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00M3 (lemma-tor-left-right), proof: tensor double complex, cokernel-complex computations and functoriality paragraph; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00M3

proof.text: Define the row augmentation to Q tensor M by the augmentation of P tensor 1 followed by braiding M tensor Q_q→Q_q tensor M. Tensor functoriality and naturality of braiding give a chain map annihilating the incoming differential.

Descend through the row cokernel. In each degree right exactness identifies the cokernel of P₁ tensor Q_q→P₀ tensor Q_q with M tensor Q_q; compose with braiding. Use ChainComplex.isIso_descOpcycles_iff: degreewise exactness follows by mapping P.exact₀ through tensorRight Q_q and transporting along ShortComplex.isoMk with braiding at the last term; the augmentation is epi since tensorRight preserves epimorphisms and braiding is invertible.

Precompose the naturality square with the row-cokernel projection. Cancel the projection after using p_descOpcycles, p_opcyclesMap, tensor composition and naturality of braiding; augmentation compatibility a₀ followed by P'.π₀=P.π₀ followed by f supplies the remaining equality. This is the private general row_tensor_square lemma in the Lean proof.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00M3, proof and functoriality paragraph, using projective resolutions (flatness and lifting suffice)

lean.statement: theorem tensorResolutionRowCokernelIso (R : Type u) [CommRing R] : ∃ e : ∀ (M N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (P : ProjectiveResolution M) (Q : ProjectiveResolution N), (tensorBicomplex P.complex Q.complex).opcycles 0 ≅ ((tensorRight M).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj Q.complex, ∀ (M N M' N' : ModuleCat.{u} R) (P : ProjectiveResolution M) (Q : ProjectiveResolution N) (P' : ProjectiveResolution M') (Q' : ProjectiveResolution N') (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') (a : P.complex ⟶ P'.complex) (b : Q.complex ⟶ Q'.complex) (_ha : a.f 0 ≫ P'.π.f 0 = P.π.f 0 ≫ f) (_hb : b.f 0 ≫ Q'.π.f 0 = Q.π.f 0 ≫ g), (e M N P Q).hom ≫ chainTensorMap b f = HomologicalComplex.opcyclesMap (tensorBicomplexMap a b) 0 ≫ (e M' N' P' Q').hom
